data.title: Slippage
data.text: Slippage is the difference between the price you expect for a trade and the price at which it fills. It grows when the order book is thin or the market moves quickly.

data.title: Slippage
data.text: Large market orders walk the book and fill at progressively worse prices, so their average fill price differs more from the best quote.
